column1: # Czech (cs) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @id                  a command id (e.g. file.saveAs): wins over the English text for
#                                 that menu item, so one id can read differently from its twin
#            @plural              `source` is "one|other" (English forms); the translation lists the
#                                 Czech forms "one|few|other" (1 | 2–4 | 0, 5+), see `plural` in
#                                 i18n/mod.rs
#            anything else        a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Czech computing vocabulary (vrstva, výběr, štětec, přechod, rozostření, krytí ...). No
# proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI was consulted or copied; in
# particular not the Czech localisation of Adobe Photoshop. Add entries the same way.
# Conventions: menus are nouns (Soubor, Úpravy, Obraz ...), commands are infinitives (Otevřít…,
# Uložit jako…), sentence case as in the English source. Product and technology names
# (PhotoCraft, ArtCraft, OpenType, CMYK, Lab ...) stay in Latin letters; the trailing "…" of
# dialog commands is kept.
